reuse_guidance: Identify present receipt before classifying a case.
Identify the unsettled residual and the future settlement requirement.
Classify whether direction A, direction B, both, or neither is relevant.
Do not classify a case as Future Debt merely because it has future costs, investment, or contractual obligations.
Separate debt existence from irreversibility and inspect rollback cost, alternatives, and future option loss.
